comparison.objective: Candidate releases a latched electrical terminal from its housing; record retrieves a loose part from beneath a guard and places it in a tray.
comparison.physical_skill: Insert one blade beneath a recessed tab while controlling a wire versus reach with a spatula, drag an unconstrained object, then grasp and place it.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate requires latch-mediated selective depinning with no housing/crimp/neighbor damage; exact force limits are missing. Record requires tool-verified extraction past a boundary, tray placement, tool return, and release.
comparison.reason: Both use a tool and pull an object out, but only the candidate tests internal latch release plus maintained wire-tool coordination.
